explanation: Fires only at D1, right after a trial where the agent chose a2, reached S2 by the common transition and got no reward: about 10 if the trials before it were rewarded (a bit lower, around 7-9, after trial 20), then about 7 and then 4 if the same no-reward a2/S2 trial happens again on the next trials. It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at every D1 after a reward, and at D1 after a no-reward trial that followed an a1 choice or a rare transition to S1.
